meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track, and read team goals + KPIs via Hivemind from openclaw. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一管理目标和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a unified way to manage goals and task progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、跟踪团队目标和关键绩效指标（KPI），也能保存待办任务并附带上下文，方便后续恢复。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项、提醒等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个目标：提升用户留存率
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并返回 ID。

say.text: 给这个目标添加一个 KPI：每月活跃用户数达到 10 万
say.note: Claude 会为已有目标添加 KPI。

say.text: 保存这个任务：修复登录页的 bug，稍后继续
say.note: Claude 会保存任务上下文，方便后续恢复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and track team goals and KPIs, and also save tasks with context for later resumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention goals, KPIs, milestones, tasks, todos, reminders, or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Create a goal: improve user retention rate
say_en.note: Claude creates the goal and returns its ID.

say_en.text: Add a KPI to this goal: 100k monthly active users
say_en.note: Claude adds a KPI to the existing goal.

say_en.text: Save this task: fix the login page bug, resume later
say_en.note: Claude saves the task context for later resumption.
